camera_selection: 24 training poses, greedy angular farthest from train_r_32; no RGB selection
geometry: CPU covariance-plane median z on exact frozen vanilla 3DGS, confidence/jump-gated TSDF; exploratory proxy, not RaDe-trained or GT; single bounded topology-preserving Taubin refinement, lower region pinned

filtering.bounds: high opacity original centers min/max plus .06, original world frame

region_provenance: authored world-height thresholds; no automatic semantics or PartField
expected_tests: camera inverse and real cached camera alignment
non-target 3D paths exact on region edit
full-object static views, weak sides and full trajectory contact sheets
scientific_scope: engineering milestone only; H1/H2 not tested; historical NO_GO and zero-headroom unchanged
exposure: Original 4 views are historically exposed. Added 4 static cameras and new orbit/zoom are frozen now before candidate output; no blind evaluation or independent geometry truth.

refinement.weights: uniform one-ring, no KNN, no weld or topology edits
refinement.face_guard: positive oriented area against original; >= 20% original area

comparison.changed_variable: proxy vertex positions only; regenerate paths with same styles
comparison.expected: less jagged seat/back paths without thinning legs or blanking visible regions
evidence: full-object source RGB / both proxies / both hatch outputs at all 8 views
mesh displacement, topology, face orientation, pinned lower vertices
path turning per arc, short paths, total length, per-region raster ink/support
source-model depth residual and silhouette; source-model depths are not independent truth
selected region edit, unchanged other regions, cold reload, HTTP editor, orbit/zoom
comparison.retention_policy: describe ink and coverage, never call fewer lines a quality improvement by itself
comparison.selection: one candidate; retain as optional if quality is mixed, no parameter sweep
